text_blocks.snippet: Sabrina’s Gengar is an iconic Stage 2 Psychic-type Pokémon card featuring Gym Leader Sabrina's signature Pokémon, released by Wizards of the Coast during the classic Gym Heroes and Gym Challenge eras of the Pokémon Trading Card Game (TCG).
snippet_highlighted_words: an iconic Stage 2 Psychic-type Pokémon card featuring Gym Leader Sabrina's signature Pokémon

list.snippet: Sabrina’s Gengar (#14/132 - Holo Rare): Released in the English Gym Heroes expansion (and Challenge from the Darkness in Japan as #094). It features artwork by Ken Sugimori with 80 HP, a -30 Fighting resistance, and a retreat cost of 1.
Sabrina’s Gengar (#29/132 - Non-Holo Rare): Released in the English Gym Challenge expansion as a regular/non-holo variant.
Pain Amplifier ([P]) places a damage counter on each of your opponent's Pokémon that already has damage counters.
Call of the Night ([PPP]) deals 40 damage and forces a coin flip check to make the opponent shuffle their Active Pokémon and all attached cards back into their deck.
The original Japanese release of the card featured artwork showing Gengar standing in a graveyard with glowing tombstones and crosses in the background.

Due to policies regarding religious imagery and tombstones on cards in Western releases, the background was altered/censored in the English version to remove the explicit graveyard elements. Because of this history, the original Japanese version [Challenge from the Darkness #094] is a sought-after piece for collectors.
Gym Heroes #14 Holo: Raw/ungraded copies generally range from $150 to $350+, while graded or 1st Edition versions command much higher prices.
Gym Challenge #29 Non-Holo: Ungraded and light-play copies typically trade around $80 to $180 depending on condition.

references.title: 2000 Pokemon Gym Challenge Sabrina's Gengar #29 PSA 7
references.snippet: The 2000 Pokemon Gym Challenge Sabrina's Gengar #29 is a classic card from one of the most beloved eras of the Pokemon Trading Card Game. Representing the signature Ghost-type Pokemon of Saffron City's Gym Leader, Sabrina, this card captures the dark, mysterious aesthetic of the Gym Challenge expansion. Graded PSA 7, this card is a fantastic addition for collectors looking to secure a piece of early Pokemon history designed by Ken Sugimori.
